7-Week Interactive Prayer Class Whether you're just beginning your prayer journey or have been praying for years, this course will challenge, equip, and strengthen your prayer life. Together, we'll explore the Power to Heal book and videos by Randy Clark, with practical biblical teaching on praying for spirit, soul, and body. Each session includes: Inspiring video teaching Interactive prayer activities Hands-on opportunities to put what you learn into practice Come expecting to grow in confidence, deepen your relationship with God, and experience a fresh impact in your personal prayer life. Cost: $16+tax · No childcare available.
